# BrightScript / BrighterScript syntax reference (for codegen)

> Distilled from this repo's device-validated ledgers so an agent writes only
> valid syntax. **This is the knowledge layer; the `bsc` hook is the gate** —
> read this before writing, then let the validator catch the rest. Authority
> order when sources conflict: **Roku device > bsc > this doc > model priors.**

## Hard rules — internalize these (they cause the most agent mistakes)

- **Case-insensitive identifiers & keywords.** `myVar`, `MyVar`, `MYVAR` are the
  same symbol; `function`/`Function`/`FUNCTION` are equivalent. Don't rely on case.
- **Significant newlines, NO line-continuation character.** A statement ends at the
  newline; there is no `_`/`\` continuation. Break long lines only *inside* an open
  `[ ]` / `{ }` collection literal or a call argument list — **not** inside a grouping
  `( )` (device rejects a newline there).
- **Type-designator suffixes** on identifiers: `$`=String, `%`=Integer, `!`=Float,
  `#`=Double, `&`=LongInteger (e.g. `name$`, `count%`).
- **No `let`** keyword on assignment — write `x = 5`, not `let x = 5`.
- **`as` type annotations accept only intrinsic types** in plain BrightScript
  (`integer`, `float`, `string`, `object`, `boolean`, `function`, `dynamic`, `void`,
  …). Custom/component/interface types in `as` are a **BrighterScript** feature.
- **Comments** are `'` or `REM`. **Conditional compilation** is `#const` / `#if` /
  `#else if` / `#else` / `#end if`, and `#if` conditions are `true|false|<CONST>`
  only — no `and`/`or`/`not`.

## Dialect boundary — `.brs` vs `.bs` (the line agents blur most)

`.brs` = **BrightScript** (what the Roku device runs). `.bs` = **BrighterScript**
(a superset that bsc *transpiles down* to `.brs`).

**BrighterScript-only — VALID in `.bs`, INVALID in `.brs`:** `class` (with
`extends`/`super()`/`override`/access modifiers/typed fields), `namespace`, `enum`,
`const`, `import`, ternary `a ? b : c`, null-coalescing `??`, template strings with
`${...}`, `new`, computed AA keys, typed params/assignments with custom & union types,
regex literals, and `@annotation`s.

When you edit a file, **pick syntax for that file's extension.** Putting any of the
above in a `.brs` file is a compile error unless the project sets
`allowBrighterScriptInBrightScript`.

## Device-confirmed gotchas

Empirically checked on real hardware (see `grammar/DEVICE_FACTS.md`). ❌ = will
not run; ⚠️ = valid but behaves surprisingly.

- ❌ **#if not/and/or (boolean operators in conditional compilation)** — _INVALID_ (BrightScript). CCExpression ::= BooleanLiteral | Identifier.
- ❌ **leading let on assignment (let x = 5)** — _INVALID_ (BrightScript). AssignmentStatement drops the optional let.
- ❌ **stringarray field init written as [a, b, c]** — _INVALID_ (SceneGraph). quote the elements: value='["a","b","c"]' (single-quote the XML attr, double-quote the strings).
- ⚠️ **roArray field type (valued, e.g. value='[1,2,3]')** — _VALID_ (SceneGraph). restored to scenegraph.ebnf FieldType as a device-confirmed extra (not in the XSD).
- ❌ **nested named function (function g() declared inside another function)** — _INVALID_ (BrightScript). decl.function.nested → device_testable:false, expect:error.
- ❌ **as interface type annotation** — _INVALID_ (BrightScript). decl.type.interface → non-device.
- ❌ **as <ComponentType> (e.g. as roSGNode) — a non-intrinsic/custom type name in an as clause** — _INVALID_ (BrightScript). decl.type.custom → non-device.
- ❌ **dim a(n) paren array bounds** — _INVALID_ (BrightScript). stmt.dim.paren → non-device.
- ❌ **optional-call ?() used as a bare expression-STATEMENT (o.fn?())** — _INVALID_ (BrightScript). stmt.expr.optcall → non-device.
- ⚠️ **next i (the next terminator followed by the counter variable)** — _VALID_ (BrightScript). kept device-valid.
- ❌ **type="str" field-type alias** — _INVALID_ (SceneGraph). sg.field.type.str_alias → non-device.
- ⚠️ **bare (non-CDATA) inline <script>…</script>** — _TOLERATED, NOT EXECUTED_ (SceneGraph). sg.script.inline_text stays device-testable, but the spec now asserts the construct is tolerated and that the bare body did not run.
- ⚠️ **scalar rect2D field runtime shape** — _roAssociativeArray_ (SceneGraph). sg.field.type.rect2d spec asserts roAssociativeArray (key count 4).
- ❌ **newline inside a grouping ( ) (e.g. x = (1 +⏎2))** — _INVALID_ (BrightScript). lex.eos.depth0_paren → non-device.
- ⚠️ **CreateObject("roInt"/"roFloat"/"roString"/"roBoolean"/"roLongInteger", value)** — _value arg IGNORED_ (BrightScript (stdlib)). box an intrinsic WITH its value via box(v) (box(5).GetInt()=5).
- ⚠️ **the ifString Mid method index base** — _0-indexed_ (BrightScript (stdlib)). the ifString Mid/Instr METHODS are 0-based, whereas the GLOBAL Mid() function is 1-based — a genuine method-vs-global divergence.
- ⚠️ **roTimespan.Mark() return** — _void (resets start)_ (BrightScript (stdlib)). read elapsed time with TotalMilliseconds() / TotalSeconds().
- ⚠️ **the modeled .bs subset — namespace, class (extends/super()/override/access modifiers/typed field init), enum, const, ternary ?:, ??, template strings + ${}, new, computed AA key, typed assignment/for each/params (custom/union/array types), regex literal, @annotation** — _VALID (runs)_ (BrighterScript (via transpile)). authored roku-test-harness/source/tests/test_bs.bs.

## Trusting (and distrusting) the bsc gate

bsc is the pre-flight checker the hook runs. It is **not** the device, so reconcile
its verdicts with these known divergences (`grammar/BSC_DRIFT.md`):

**bsc is too STRICT here — the construct is VALID on device.** A red line for one
of these is a false positive; keep the construct and suppress with
`' bs:disable-next-line`, do not "fix" it away:

- **next i — next + counter variable** `stmt.for.next_var` — bsc: REJECT (BS1039 "Expected newline or ':'", BS1066); device: ACCEPT (runs; spec PASS). Construct kept (device-valid).

**bsc is too LENIENT here — it passes, but the DEVICE REJECTS. Never ship these:**

- **o.fn?() — optional-call as a bare statement** `stmt.expr.optcall` — bsc: ACCEPT; device: REJECT (compile &h02). Construct is device-invalid → moved to corpus/negative/.
- **type="str" — SceneGraph field-type alias** `sg.field.type.str_alias` — bsc: ACCEPT (no SG field-type semantic check); device: REJECT (valued str field reads Invalid). Device-invalid → corpus/negative/.

**bsc can't see runtime here — trust the device behaviour:**

- **bare (non-CDATA) inline <script> execution** `sg.script.inline_text` — bsc: ACCEPT (cannot model SG runtime); device: TOLERATE but DON'T EXECUTE (init() never runs). Spec asserts the device-true behaviour (tolerated, body does not run).
